- [Total cherry blossoms per
  neighbourhood](#total-cherry-blossoms-per-neighbourhood)
- [Cherry blossom density per
  neighbourhood](#cherry-blossom-density-per-neighbourhood)

``` r
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(mapgl)
library(DT)
library(here)
```

``` r
neighbourhoods <- st_read(here("data/original/local-area-boundary.geojson"), quiet = TRUE)
cherry_trees   <- st_read(here("data/final/cherry_blossoms.geojson"), quiet = TRUE)

cherry_trees <- st_transform(cherry_trees, st_crs(neighbourhoods))
```

``` r
# Count trees per neighbourhood via spatial join
tree_neighbourhood <- st_join(cherry_trees, neighbourhoods, join = st_within)

tree_counts <- tree_neighbourhood %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(name, name = "tree_count")

# Join counts back; calculate area and density
neighbourhoods <- neighbourhoods %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6) %>%
  left_join(tree_counts, by = "name") %>%
  mutate(
    tree_count    = replace(tree_count, is.na(tree_count), 0),
    trees_per_km2 = tree_count / area_km2
  )
```

## Total cherry blossoms per neighbourhood

``` r
maplibre(style = openfreemap_style("bright"), bounds = neighbourhoods) %>%
  add_fill_layer(
    id           = "neighbourhood-count",
    source       = neighbourhoods,
    fill_color   = interpolate(
      column   = "tree_count",
      values   = c(0, median(neighbourhoods$tree_count), max(neighbourhoods$tree_count)),
      stops    = c("#fff7ec", "#fc8d59", "#7f0000"),
      na_color = "#cccccc"
    ),
    fill_opacity = 0.75,
    tooltip      = "name",
    popup        = concat(
      "<b>", get_column("name"), "</b><br/>",
      "Cherry blossoms: ", get_column("tree_count")
    )
  ) %>%
  add_line_layer(
    id           = "neighbourhood-borders",
    source       = neighbourhoods,
    line_color   = "white",
    line_width   = 1,
    line_opacity = 0.8
  ) %>%
  add_continuous_legend(
    legend_title = "Total cherry blossoms",
    values       = c(0, max(neighbourhoods$tree_count)),
    colors       = c("#fff7ec", "#7f0000"),
    position     = "bottom-right"
  )
```

``` r
neighbourhoods %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    Neighbourhood   = name,
    `Total trees`   = tree_count,
    `Area (km²)`    = round(area_km2, 2),
    `Trees per km²` = round(trees_per_km2, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Total trees`)) %>%
  datatable(
    caption  = "Neighbourhoods ranked by total cherry blossoms",
    rownames = FALSE,
    options  = list(pageLength = 22, dom = "t")
  )
```

## Cherry blossom density per neighbourhood

``` r
maplibre(style = openfreemap_style("bright"), bounds = neighbourhoods) %>%
  add_fill_layer(
    id           = "neighbourhood-density",
    source       = neighbourhoods,
    fill_color   = interpolate(
      column   = "trees_per_km2",
      values   = c(0, median(neighbourhoods$trees_per_km2), max(neighbourhoods$trees_per_km2)),
      stops    = c("#f7fcf0", "#41ab5d", "#00441b"),
      na_color = "#cccccc"
    ),
    fill_opacity = 0.75,
    tooltip      = "name",
    popup        = concat(
      "<b>", get_column("name"), "</b><br/>",
      "Trees per km²: ", number_format(get_column("trees_per_km2"), 1), "<br/>",
      "Total trees: ", get_column("tree_count"), "<br/>",
      "Area: ", number_format(get_column("area_km2"), 2), " km²"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_line_layer(
    id           = "neighbourhood-borders",
    source       = neighbourhoods,
    line_color   = "white",
    line_width   = 1,
    line_opacity = 0.8
  ) %>%
  add_continuous_legend(
    legend_title = "Cherry blossoms per km²",
    values       = c(0, max(neighbourhoods$trees_per_km2)),
    colors       = c("#f7fcf0", "#00441b"),
    position     = "bottom-right"
  )
```

``` r
neighbourhoods %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    Neighbourhood   = name,
    `Total trees`   = tree_count,
    `Area (km²)`    = round(area_km2, 2),
    `Trees per km²` = round(trees_per_km2, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Trees per km²`)) %>%
  datatable(
    caption  = "Neighbourhoods ranked by cherry blossom density",
    rownames = FALSE,
    options  = list(pageLength = 22, dom = "t")
  )
```
